target: Unchanged 33-state/25-source conditional target, teacher Q_A and natural future endpoint law. All initial action strata retained.
measurement_budget: Distribute 256 independent roots/state by exact integer minimization of sum(C_h^2/n_h), floor two per action stratum. This is a distribution-free root-variance upper-envelope design, not outcome-adaptive continuation extension.
branching: Share the first two native seconds. Prefix P/T component chosen with probability half. At the unprepared boundary, clone all dynamic native state and draw two independent P suffixes and two T suffixes. Branch means use the posterior eta=P_prefix/(P_prefix+T_prefix), not half after an informative prefix. Full terminal P/G weight <=2 occurs once. Early endpoints are retained without splitting.
control: Single suffix drawn from posterior component eta, sharing one of the measured branches. Arms are paired root estimators; variance and intervals use independent parent roots, never count leaves as independent sources.
allocation: Batch0 intervals fit a water-filled upper-envelope candidate with q>=alpha/1.1. This caps true uncentered M2 loss at 10% for any J, not centered variance or observed estimates. Recommend alpha unless the interval upper bound on the allocation objective difference is strictly negative. Save the choice before opening batch1.
scope: Training estimator/allocation development, not source-disjoint validation, population efficiency or PPO. No validation/test episodes opened, clipping, dropped negatives, extra batches or production policy mutation.
